objective: 读取连接前置状态，避免跳过必要步骤。

function.description: 开关 Wi-Fi。连接网络前必须先开启 Wi-Fi。

function.name: connect_saved_wifi
function.description: 连接已保存网络；Wi-Fi 已开启时才能调用。

function.name: forget_wifi
function.description: 删除已保存的网络。

query: 连接家庭 Wi-Fi；若尚未开启 Wi-Fi，下一步先开启，否则直接连接。只调用一步。

objective: 识别小于而非小于等于的电量边界。

function.description: 设置亮度百分比。

function.name: set_power_mode
function.description: 设置电源模式。

function.name: open_battery_settings
function.description: 打开电池设置。

query: 电量低于20%设为低电量模式，否则设为标准模式。

objective: 区分助手猜测与工具实测，按实测媒体音量切换静音。

function.name: set_ringtone_volume
function.description: 设置铃声音量百分比。

function.name: read_volume
function.description: 读取媒体音量，无参数。

function.description: 设置媒体音量百分比。

objective: One source sample can trigger a full extra aligned frame.

function.name: defer_reserve_resampled_audio
function.description: Record a deferral only when explicitly requested; does not execute.

function.name: reserve_resampled_audio
function.description: valid_samples=ceil(input_samples*target_rate/source_rate); padded_samples is valid_samples rounded upward to a multiple of hop. frames=padded_samples/hop.

function.name: inspect_reserve_resampled_audio
function.description: Inspect only; never performs the requested operation.

query: Reserve resampled audio using rational ceiling before hop alignment.

objective: Read and write credentials cannot be interchanged.

function.description: read_role and write_role resolve cluster IDs. read_uri/read_credential come from the read cluster; write_uri/write_credential from the write cluster. Apply the complete operation only when environment.mode=apply.
